responsibility: This implementation module provides floating-point and long-integer textual I/O by combining line-based StrIO operations with DynamicStrings/StringConvert conversion helpers. It reads textual numbers from standard input, converts between REAL or LONGREAL and formatted strings with total and fractional widths, and likewise handles LONGINT conversion, making it the gm2 runtime’s fixed-format bridge between numeric values and character representations beyond the simpler CARDINAL/INTEGER facilities in NumberIO.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for FpuIO, providing the actual stdin/stdout reading and writing paths and DynamicStrings/StringConvert-based conversions that back the procedure declarations in FpuIO.def.
